card.name: LIB-FIX-07 — Apply restored master gains before saving
card.description:
## Reproduced core gain/persistence defect — 3 November 2026
Normal Library tools → Restore backup saved Master Output Level/Master Volume without applying current audio-engine/header gains. Browser RED: successful restore of −6dB/50%, Settings50%, header still0.0dB; reload applied −6/50. Actual handler + actual app setters + AudioEngine method regression retained master−10 instead of requested−6.

## Bounded repair and acceptance
- [x] Two existing app setters after validated settings merge, save:false; existing single durable save. No DSP/default/new abstraction.
- [x] Focused actual-source regression RED→GREEN;10 adjacent restore/recovery checks pass. Explicit legacy check retains−10/.75 when gains omitted; malformed backups remain rejected before mutation.
- [x] Actual browser normal file picker: reload baseline−6/50 → neutral0/100 restore applies header/settings immediately, stopped/silent.117controls and5ready preview sources retained. Existing restore redraw is intentional; no node-identity claim.
- [ ] Deliver and observe same restore path in next desktop candidate. Installed138 remains untouched; no native repair/delivery claim.

Not established cause of Jason's Serato comparison or intermittent pops. No music playback, PCM/listening/reference/hardware acceptance. Main session/original audio/saved levels/unrelated draft untouched. Existing controls, layouts and library previews retained. No broad test suite or new build.
Related LIB-011; CORE-FIX-75 remains open for fair level calibration/listening. Separate from missing-file metadata/import recovery and prior malformed-backup validation; existing restore/LIB-FIX search found no same named gain-application defect.
Evidence: https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/blob/codex/core-four-deck-trace/docs/prototype/LIBRARY_RESTORE_MASTER_2026-11-03.json
Primary Codex gpt-6.1-sol/high; parent Claude alternatives remain recommendations subject to availability. No agent invocation implied.
